scope: Final DEVELOPMENT source/evidence review, before formal GLOBAL envelope. W05/W06 live final dependency blocked; W17 holdout out of scope.

prior_findings.evidence: Identical original early-config raw bytes/hash now produce error and nil report; independent 11-field observed mismatch matrix (including engine name and version separately) rejects without report. Raw-only parsing and immutable native receipt provide original-data binding.
Previous 8ebaa4c native six-root/source-ACL review retained; sandbox_windows.go unchanged since that review, so no redundant directory matrix rerun.

findings.title: Native protocol runner overwrites ERROR or ABSTAIN when partial selected value matches label
findings.trigger: PROTOCOL_FIXTURE with all true hard input conditions and simulated_provider_output containing selected=ADOPT plus provider_error=timeout (or abstain=true), expected_decision=ADOPT.
findings.expected: Preserve provider ERROR or ABSTAIN and their counts; a partial selected value must not erase terminal provider state.
findings.actual: Execute first sets ERROR/ABSTAIN with Hard=nil, then final selected==expected&&hard branch overwrites Verdict=PASS; Normalize turns it into FAIL due to nil Hard. error_count/abstain_count becomes0 and fail_count1.
findings.impact: Incorrect C21 failure/abstention accounting; not a false accepted candidate or observed hard-gate bypass.
findings.recommendation: Keep terminal provider error/abstention handling after or exclusive of selected-label scoring, and preserve original raw reason/status.
